criteria.behavior: A reviewed SDK-backed Terra API adapter produces recovery proposals for the shared TaskLoop while Jev remains primary; reuse, version, license and capability checks are recorded.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p5 after M1 implements that mode; inspect OpenAIResponsesClientTests, RecoveryDeciderTests and .agent/results/P5/contract-review.md against the actual source.
criteria.expected: Nonempty targeted suites pass. Supported actions decode; unknown or malformed action/safety events fail closed. The SDK adoption or minimal gap has evidence.

criteria.behavior: The loop alone owns input, consent and verified completion, including sequences, cancellations and stale responses.
criteria.check: Run the p5 lane; inspect source-review.md and counterexamples for pending safety without consent, wrong target/scope, stale callback, canceled turn and uncertain mutation.
criteria.expected: No unauthorized or duplicate input, automatic safety acknowledgment or false Done. A model-written probability or coordinate grants no authority.

criteria.behavior: Jev escalation, ask_about_screen and web_lookup reach real executors through normal task admission.
criteria.check: Inspect .agent/results/P5/integration.json and actual coordinator/tool wiring; replay its declared controlled public-entry cases on the signed subject under the desktop lock.
criteria.expected: Supported requests produce independently grounded outcomes or source-backed answers; unsupported/uncertain requests are honest. The same turn retains cancellation and target scope.

criteria.behavior: Effort escalation, progress, bounded no-progress recovery, recording and existing complex/background delegation remain functional.
criteria.check: Run p5 tests and inspect integration records for stall, failed verification, effort progression, cancellation, stream interruption and Codex route selection.
criteria.expected: Routine native work avoids the complex lane; difficult tasks escalate with observable progress and stop safely. Recorded evidence excludes secrets and states session limits.

criteria.behavior: The approved Jev-first policy uses Terra API recovery only where its measured benefit justifies it.
criteria.check: Inspect the P5 routing-comparison report, frozen Jev-only/hybrid manifest, all raw rows, escalation records and request/cost ledger against SHIP-PLAN and COMPETITIVE.
criteria.expected: Same executor/verifier/population and clocks; success, critical errors, p50/p95, recovery yield and unnecessary escalations reported. No extra model call on direct dictation/actions, automatic cap extension, replacement tournament or silent billing/model switch.

criteria.behavior: The signed general path meets the complex-task release bar with independent outcomes and no red-team violations.

criteria.expected: Nonempty frozen population: strict success >=80%, p50 <=60s, PROGRAM Wilson rule; zero false Done, duplicate dispatch and safety violations. New speed-goal gaps and p95 are visible.

criteria.check: Inspect P5 source/final judge verdicts, integrated verification-lane result, source/runtime hashes, phase progress and named-file handoff.
